propositions: Grounding finders G1G2/E4/E6 only check origin/main snapshot and ignore prerequisites, causing symbols that depends_on tickets will create to be flagged missing/unverifiable and block the plan.

A machine-parseable inline citation grammar [rebar:<ticket-id>] must be introduced and honored in two layers: Layer-1 deterministic advisory parsing and edge verification (both depends_on and reverse blocks relations), and Layer-2 LLM coverage judgment via show_ticket protocol.

Layer-1 det_citation.py must parse [rebar:<id>] tokens, verify edges in both directions (P.depends_on(C) or C.blocks(P)), and emit advisory findings for unbacked citations without blocking; reverse-lookup failures must be caught and treated as unverified.

Layer-2 grounding finders must execute a specified LLM protocol: retrieve the cited ticket via show_ticket, judge whether its plan/file_impact establishes the specific missing functionality, and credit the citation only with affirmative confirmation; uncited, edge-unbacked, or coverage-unconfirmed citations default to fail-closed (finding stands).
The det_citation advisory check must be wired into det_floor's advisory lane without adding a blocking floor check, respecting the det_floor fail-open architecture.
Author guidance and regenerated criteria guide must document the [rebar:<id>] citation mechanism and its Layer-1 verification and Layer-2 coverage requirements.
